title: accepted into IIT Madras for undergrad
note: two years of JEE grind and finally, got into the college that (my parents and) I always wanted to get into. gonna be a fun four years.

title: went to YC startup school in Bangalore
note: applied last minute with no hopes but somehow i got in. honestly, the night before i was getting crazy imposter syndrome thinking "what the hell am i doing here, i havent done enough to be here". i was quite nervous, afraid i'd look like a moron. but it was a lot of fun. "inspiring and humbling" were the two words i could think of to summarise the day. i got to meet a lot of crack builders, got a crazy amount of AI credits from YC and most importantly, got a hugee amount of motivation to actually build more. and i've been building a lot more (token-maxxing) ever since. probably the most significant moment for me in a very very long time.

title: part of IIM Ahmedabad's AI summer residency program
note: selected as one of 40 residents from more than 33,000 applicants. spent five weeks living on the IIM Ahmedabad campus in a high-intensity program built around deep-work sprints, hands-on technical guidance, and exposure to real users.

title: placed third at the OpenAI Codex Community Hackathon
note: the only solo builder to make it into the top five. built Workprint.
